textbookBox.concept: Ritika lives in the Rajasthan desert. A desert is a dry land that gets very little rain and has sandy soil, so very few plants can grow.

beats.en: Ritika lives in the Rajasthan desert. A desert is a dry land that gets very little rain and has sandy soil, so very few plants can grow.
beats.speakEn: Ritika lives in the Rajasthan desert. A desert is a dry land that gets very little rain and has sandy soil, so very few plants can grow.

beats.en: Chandni lives in Puri, on the coast. A coast is the land next to the sea. Many people there are fishermen. They catch fish and sell them, and they know the sea very well.
